items.title: Proptech unicorn EliseAI raises $350M at $4B valuation
items.note: a16z and Bessemer lead round that nearly doubles its valuation, platform now powers 1 in 6 US apartments

items.title: Bain Capital invests $250M in construction platform Kahua, crossing $1B valuation
items.note: largest outside investor takes minority stake as AI megaproject platform hits $100M ARR

items.title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with Anthropic, Microsoft and 100+ partners
items.note: OpenShell and Sentry move agent containment into silicon, shifting safety from the model layer to infrastructure

items.title: Maryland and Alabama deed theft protections take effect as states tighten title-fraud rules
items.note: 12 states now have dedicated deed theft laws, up from 7 in April, but 29 states still have none

items.title: Israeli fintech unicorn Capitolis buys securities-lending firm eSecLending for $200M
items.note: all-cash deal is Capitolis' fourth acquisition in five years, adds securities lending to its platform

items.title: Israeli AI marketing startup enso to acquire two ad agencies for up to $25M
items.note: PPG Digital and US-based LeadCoverage add ~50 staff, days after enso's $15M Series A
